title: Codex review of 0.9.1a–0.9.2: 12 findings to triage and fix before ABI freeze
body:
Source: Codex read-only review (run apex-0-9-review-1a-2) of 573fbe1..a5335a2. Unverified by me yet.
P1: (1) registrations outlive host/unloaded libs, plugin_host.cpp:256/264; (2) plugin tool state changes don't publishToolStatus, plugin_tool.cpp:64; (3) preset pie with omitted/duplicate/>8 slots crashes, preset_io.cpp:141; (4) host exceptions can cross plugin frames, plugin_host.cpp:202.
P2: (5) unsized array element structs (apex_tool_parameter/segment/ghost/suggestion) block append-only evolution, apex_plugin.h:93; (6) apex_tool_event tail padding, apex_plugin.h:70; (7) namespace prefix overlap com.example vs com.example.paint, plugin_host.cpp:189; (8) ghost preview overwritten by another pane's input, plugin_tool.cpp:84; (9) key identities dropped (modalKeyName), plugin_tool.cpp:60; (10) no owns()/gesture ownership for plugin tools; (11) tool id with trailing dot passes registration but aborts session construction; (12) suggested shortcuts show unbound in settings_dialog.cpp:607.
Items 5, 6 must be decided before the ABI freeze. Fix after 0.9.3 lands (touches plugin_tool.cpp).

comments.text: P1s 1-4 confirmed real (5 regression tests failed first) and fixed in the commit after bb86c82; I verified 227 tests pass. P2s 5-12 still open; 5 and 6 must be decided before the ABI freeze.
